B40.capture_spec: C21: 17-crosshair at defaults, 30 fps, `--length` = the measured audio of B40 (about 10.5 s). Two dials back to back, each from 0 to 1 and ending on 1 (the voice says 'grows' and 'pushes the ring outward'); the first dial stays at 1.0 while the second moves. dot_size: default 0.5 held to 9 %, down to 0 by 15 %, hold at 0 to 19 %, up to 1 by 37 %, hold to 100 %; then ring_distance: default 0.55 held to 38 %, down to 0 by 44 %, hold at 0 to 56 %, up to 1 by 74 %, hold to 100 %. The 50 % frame is inside ring_distance's hold at 0 (with dot_size at 1.0) and the 85 % frame in the final hold (both at 1.0). Scripted. Harness: `--animate dot_size:0.00:0.5,0.09:0.5,0.15:0,0.19:0,0.37:1,1.00:1` and `--animate ring_distance:0.00:0.55,0.38:0.55,0.44:0,0.56:0,0.74:1,1.00:1`.
B40.visual_intent: Code card at left (lines 1 to 8: the six uniforms; the one being moved is highlighted); at right a real Godot window: dot size drops to 0 and grows to 1, then ring distance drops to 0 and grows to 1 while the arms stay put. A readout names the dial and its value at each hold, at the top-left of the window.

B43.capture_spec: C24: 17-crosshair, 30 fps, `--length` = the measured audio of B43 (about 13 s), STEPPED (`--steps`: instant changes, no ramps), as fractions of the clip: defaults to 27 %; arm_length = 0 from 27 % to 38 % (the voice says 'The dot and the ring'); the defaults again from 38 % to 50 % while 'Ring width at zero?' is asked (the 50 % frame is a settled state); ring_width = 0 from 50 % to 61 % ('The dot and the arms'); all six dials = 1.0 from 61 % to the end (the 85 % frame). Scripted. Harness: `--steps dot_size:0:0.5,0.61:1 --steps ring_distance:0:0.55,0.61:1 --steps ring_width:0:0.3,0.5:0,0.61:1 --steps arm_gap:0:0.35,0.61:1 --steps arm_length:0:0.6,0.27:0,0.38:0.6,0.61:1 --steps arm_width:0:0.4,0.61:1`.

The crosshair at its defaults ('predict first'); the readout 'arm length 0?' asks, then the state jumps to arm length 0 (dot and ring) as the answer is voiced; the picture goes back to the defaults while 'ring width 0?' asks, then jumps to ring width 0 (dot and arms) as that answer is voiced; then every dial at 1 (everything at its largest). Readouts sit at the top-left of the window and name each state.
